rows.en: ＊Tomoe＊＠１８４＿０２８No. I'll work as hard as I can￥so I don't hold you back...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８４＿０２９Actually, I should be the one￥asking. Please... let me be￥your partner.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Tomoe Depart　－
＊Tomoe＊＠１７１＿０１５Getting to go to Elan...￥It's like a dream.＝＠１７１＿０１６I'm not good enough yet...￥I might end up causing you￥trouble...＝＠１７１＿０１７But I'll work hard, so I can￥help you, even just a little.
＊Tomoe＊＠１７１＿０１８I... I'm truly glad I met you.＝＠１７１＿０１９Because you were there, I was￥able to become stronger.＝＠１７１＿０２０So from now on, I want to be the￥one who supports you...＝＠１７１＿０２１I'll do my best.

＊Tomoe＊＠１７１＿０２２I... always looked up to people￥like you.＝＠１７１＿０２３Strong and kind... You were￥always there to support me.＝＠１７１＿０２４So from now on, I want to be the￥one who supports you...＝＠１７１＿０２５I'll do my best.＝＠１７１＿０２６So I can be worthy of you￥choosing me...
